verdict.rationale: Formant documents a data-export path: a guide titled "Data export with the Python Cloud SDK" lets data scientists query telemetry programmatically. Device configuration can also be exported to YAML, an open format. It does not show a complete account export or the formats telemetry comes out in. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or complete export of all data (telemetry, assets, video, events), explicit open export formats for telemetry and media, offboarding or account-exit guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
